description: This file defines a class `RetrieveThingsSignalMapper` that extends `AbstractQuerySignalMapper` and is responsible for mapping `RetrieveThings` commands to signals, constructing topic paths and payloads for retrieving things in a cloud protocol context.

classes.name: RetrieveThingsSignalMapper
classes.description: A final class responsible for mapping RetrieveThings commands to appropriate signals, constructing topic paths and payloads according to the command specifics.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Builds a topic path based on the namespace found in the RetrieveThings command, defaulting to a placeholder if absent.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Enhances the payload by setting selected fields and including the list of Thing IDs.

methods.name: createIdsPayload
methods.description: Creates a JSON payload array of Thing IDs from a collection of ThingId objects.
